summary: Aterian filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Trademark Global, LLC, which will acquire certain specified assets and liabilities including marquee brands Mueller Living, PurSteam, hOmeLabs, Squatty Potty, Healing Solutions, and Photo Paper Direct for $18 million in cash, subject to purchase price adjustments. The board has not yet stated a recommendation; closing requires stockholder approval and achievement of contribution margin targets. The deal is not subject to a financing condition. Watch for stockholder vote timing and margin performance; risk-arb spread hinges on approval and operational milestones.
